title: Chameleons Change Colors
subtitle: Vocabulary Reflex
sourceAlignmentNoteKo: 단어는 업로드된 worksheet 이미지의 vocabulary 표를 기준으로 만들었고, 지문은 사용자가 지정한 두 문장만 포함했습니다. 현재 단어들은 지문 안에 직접 등장하지 않으므로 daily vocabulary reflex 용도로 구성했습니다.

sentences.text: Chameleons are famous for being able to change colors.

chunks.text: for being able to change colors.
for being able to change colors.

sentences.text: Sometimes, they change colors to blend into their surroundings.

vocabulary.easyEnglish: to put a thing at a high place
vocabulary.easyEnglishLong: When you hang something, you put it up high, like on a wall or a hook, so it stays there.
examples: I always hang my coat on the wall.

comic.meaning: to put a thing at a high place

panels.caption: Kibu has a warm coat.
Kibu reaches up very high.
Kibu hangs the coat on the wall.
Now the coat hangs up high!

reflexProfile.coreCue: to put a thing at a high place
reflexProfile.readingBridge: This word comes from the vocabulary file. Connect hang to: to put a thing at a high place.

vocabulary.easyEnglish: a small ball that keeps moths away from clothes
vocabulary.easyEnglishLong: A mothball is a small white ball. People put it near clothes to keep bugs away.
vocabulary.simpleKo: 옷에서 벌레를 쫓는 작은 흰 공
examples: She has mothballs in her closet.

comic.meaning: a small ball that keeps moths away

panels.caption: Bugs come near the clothes!
Kibu brings a small white mothball.
The mothball keeps the bugs away.
Now the clothes are safe!

reflexProfile.coreCue: a small ball that keeps moths away from clothes
reflexProfile.readingBridge: This word comes from the vocabulary file. Connect mothball to: a small ball that keeps moths away from clothes.

vocabulary.easyEnglish: a thing made by changing its first state
vocabulary.easyEnglishLong: A chemical is something made when things change and mix into something new.
examples: Some gardeners use chemicals to kill insects.

panels.caption: Kibu mixes two things together.
They start to change!
Now it is a new chemical.
A chemical is made by changing!

reflexProfile.coreCue: a thing made by changing its first state
reflexProfile.readingBridge: This word comes from the vocabulary file. Connect chemical to: a thing made by changing its first state.

vocabulary.easyEnglish: a strong-smelling thing used in mothballs
vocabulary.easyEnglishLong: Naphthalene is the strong-smelling chemical inside a mothball. The smell keeps bugs away.

panels.caption: Kibu sniffs a small white ball.
It is naphthalene inside the mothball.
The strong smell keeps bugs away.
Naphthalene smells very strong!

reflexProfile.coreCue: a strong-smelling thing used in mothballs
reflexProfile.readingBridge: This word comes from the vocabulary file. Connect naphthalene to: a strong-smelling thing used in mothballs.

vocabulary.easyEnglish: to slowly disappear into a liquid
vocabulary.easyEnglishLong: When something dissolves, it mixes into a liquid and slowly disappears, like sugar in water.
examples: The sugar dissolved in her coffee.

comic.meaning: to slowly disappear into a liquid

panels.caption: Kibu drops sugar into the water.
Kibu stirs it round and round.
The sugar dissolves and disappears!
Now the sugar is gone. It dissolved!

reflexProfile.coreCue: to slowly disappear into a liquid
reflexProfile.readingBridge: This word comes from the vocabulary file. Connect dissolve to: to slowly disappear into a liquid.

vocabulary.easyEnglish: the changing of a solid into a gas
vocabulary.easyEnglishLong: Sublimation is when a solid turns straight into a gas, with no liquid in between.
examples: Sublimation makes solids change into gases.

comic.meaning: a solid changing into a gas

panels.caption: Kibu looks at a hard solid.
The solid turns into gas.
No water! Solid goes straight to gas.
This is sublimation: solid to gas!

reflexProfile.coreCue: the changing of a solid into a gas
reflexProfile.readingBridge: This word comes from the vocabulary file. Connect sublimation to: the changing of a solid into a gas.

vocabulary.easyEnglishLong: When you heat something, you make it hot, like warming a pan on the stove.
examples: I heated the oil in the frying pan.

panels.caption: Kibu has a cold pan.
Kibu heats the pan with fire.
The pan gets very, very hot.
Heat makes things hot!

reflexProfile.readingBridge: This word comes from the vocabulary file. Connect heat to: to make something hot.

vocabulary.easyEnglish: to change from a liquid into a solid because of cold
vocabulary.easyEnglishLong: When water freezes, the cold turns it into hard, solid ice.
examples: The water in the lake freezes and turns into ice.

comic.meaning: liquid turns to solid in the cold

panels.caption: Kibu has a glass of water.
Kibu puts it in the cold.
The water freezes into hard ice.
Freezing makes water a solid!

reflexProfile.coreCue: to change from a liquid into a solid because of cold
reflexProfile.readingBridge: This word comes from the vocabulary file. Connect freeze to: to change from a liquid into a solid because of cold.
